title: C: Simple Regex Matcher
description: Implement a simple regex engine that supports ., *, and + operators.

steps.title: Match with . and *
steps.description: Write a recursive function `int match(char *regex, char *text)` that supports `.` (any char) and `*` (zero or more of preceding char). Test: match("a*b", "b") = 1, match("a.b", "axb") = 1, match("ab*c", "abc") = 1.
hints: If next char is *, try matching 0 or more occurrences.
Base cases: if regex empty -> text empty.
If regex[0] == text[0] or regex[0] == '.', recurse on rest.
